 CHANDIGARH ADMINISTRATION DECLARE PUBLIC HOLIDAY ON ACCOUNT OF GOVARDHAN POOJA AND VISHWAKARMA DAY ON NOV. 9
 06 November 2026 
 By admin 
 Face2News/Chandigarh  
 In partial modification of this Administration’s Notification No. 6/1/1-IH(I) -2025/ 17488-95, dated 30.12.2025 regarding declaring of Public Holidays in the Union Territory of Chandigarh during the calendar year 2026, the 09th November (Monday) will now be observed as “Public Holiday” instead of “Restricted Holiday”. A notification in this regard have been issued by Mr. Mandip Singh Brar, IAS Home Secretary Chandigarh Administration. 
 On 9th November, all the Government Offices/ Boards/ Corporations/ Institutions including Industrial Establishments under the Chandigarh Administration, will be closed as per the notification.
